ns2:section.sectionText: In this course, students will explore and examine advertising practices and brand experiences related to tourism and travel for international destinations or "place brands." The class will develop knowledge and skills related to how destinations abroad use media, attractions, events, people, history, government, businesses and culture to tell their brand stories and create brand identities in the context of a global tourism marketplace. Experiential learning and immersive activities abroad in London and Paris will allow students to gain cultural competencies and global perspectives related to international travel and tourism. Request instructor approval at: https://forms.illinois.edu/sec/5802304 Course requires travel in May, 2019 for approximately 14 days in London + Paris. Instructor approval is required for the course.
